notes.title: Games Release!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

My Shadow has finally released on STEAM! 

This passion project of mine has undergone so many changes over the past year and an unbelievable amount of features taken away, that's game dev for ya.

As a solo developer, coming from an art background, coding is an incredible difficult thing to learn. And the fact that I have created a functioning(?) game from nothing, is incredibly rewarding. 

The main direction with this project was that I wanted to tell a story through the environment. The Dollhouse idea was suggested to me in a university lecture, and has since developed into what the game is today. 

I would like to thank everyone who helped me create this vision:

My Friends and Family
1 Queen Bee
Lloyd Hickman
Sasha Gallie
Josh Griffin
Position / DukeStoner
University of Hertfordshire


You may come across some game breaking bugs when playing. If you do, please post what you found on the community page so that I can fix the problem. 



Thanks for playing my game! Have Fun!
